recommendations.action: Use .scratch/pages-historical-exhibits-20261014-v3 as the single canonical portable browser staging tree.
recommendations.why: It carries 8,435 Pages output records, 36 image overlays, the current historical exhibit output, and current export provenance. Keep the source manifest SHA tied to 397f7dcdbc774d80c6f8c1f3dabf7933211ff182427bd2ef77c895752334f459.

recommendations.action: Retain each older Pages tree only as a named snapshot with its export-provenance.json and a compact v3 diff record; do not treat equal file names as equal content.
recommendations.why: The five older trees occupy 2,783,324,277 logical bytes together. Compared with v3, the older variants differ in 639–648 output hashes; the four 8,435-record variants differ only in HTML, while the early resources tree also differs in JS and Pages support records and has 18 missing records.

recommendations.action: Keep artifacts/WOW_Encyclopedia_20080512_runtime_20261013.zip and its sidecar byte-for-byte unchanged.
recommendations.why: The existing runtime archive is 49048568821e307c03764d486e76ab952b4aea460dd38ccf53f973263386c115 and its current bytes match the sidecar. It is a separate 2008 runtime deliverable and should not be regenerated from the v3 Pages tree.

recommendations.action: Before publishing a new portable ZIP, build a source-root-aware packer or wrapper that includes the v3 tree, export-provenance.json, the accepted 36 image overlays, historical exhibits, the 50 directory fixes, and a loopback launcher/server; verify the finished ZIP by streamed SHA, CRC, length, and whitelist checks.
recommendations.why: tools/package_runtime_archive.py hardcodes offline/site, offline/build-manifest.json, offline/support, and runtime launcher inputs. It has no source-root, Pages-export, overlay, or v3 provenance option, so it cannot directly package v3.

recommendations.action: Use the existing measured compression profile for budgeting, then package once after acceptance.
recommendations.why: The offline/site report measured 38,772,435 bytes saved from text and 4,169,355 from images; the v3 payload is 549,434,795 raw bytes with an estimated 499,706,618 compressed bytes. This is an estimate, not a new archive result.

recommendations.action: Keep at least 10 GiB plus 256 MiB free on D: before any future write, and use a separate temporary output directory for the new archive.
recommendations.why: The current inventory is read-only and D: was checked against the project safety threshold. No deletion, move, NTFS compression, or packaging was performed by this report.
